interpretation.scope_limit: D21 is a short unadmitted 125-us/eight-step diagnostic. It does not establish anatomical fit, full joint range, continuous contact, muscle-driven range of motion, biological or clinical qualification.
interpretation.static_skin_ROI_scope: The detailed static ROI and 069i hand/wrist surface audits use skin payload SHA a848a413..., whereas D20/D21 runtime uses refined skin payload SHA d4353d53.... interpretation.toe_scope: The source model has one shared toes body per foot and one aggregate MTP DOF per side; there are no independent toe or IP DOFs. md2-md5 rows are hand fingers, verified by parent/child chain.

hand_vs_foot_name_chain_assertion.assertion: md2-md5 flexion q rows resolve to hand phalanx child bodies; foot q rows resolve only to ankle/subtalar calcn bodies and one MTP child toes_r/l.

explicit_representation_limits: Elbow MCL anterior/posterior and LUCL rows are intentionally omitted because bounded supported-pose searches found no all-185-clear non-inward straight line for this owner; RCL is a regional proxy and there is no separate annular-ligament body.
Lumbar catalog covers only the four midline L1-L2 through L4-L5 resultants; cervical and thoracic interspinous coverage is absent.
Knee rows are prohibited by the registered-catalog ownership policy; inferred ACL, when selected, is a separate existing owner path.
CHL/CC/hip/ankle rows are inferred zero-prestrain regional springs, not measured person-specific entheses; open surface-mesh clearance does not prove closed-solid containment.
